thread:
maria (pm): quick sync — i'm drafting the pilot recruitment gating + feedback routing doc. need decisions on incentive, mandatory telemetry, and who owns escalation. can we align now? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

sam (eng): i can take ownership of the telemetry schema. want to avoid excessive event volume — propose a lite + verbose mode.

elaine (product): +1 on modes. lightweight: prompts + top-level outcome. verbose: full turn-level tokens + timing. heavyweight only for 2-3 partners.

jordan (solutions): for customer-facing partners we should require a short integration checklist: api key in prod sandbox, sample flows, contact for SRE. keeps support load predictable.

carol (growth): incentives: thinking $300 Amazon card vs bumping to paid credits. referral program idea: if a partner brings another partner we double their credits. which is cheaper?

maria (pm): noted. two asks: 1) gating rubric (score-based) for acceptance 2) feedback routing (where do bug reports vs product asks vs success stories go).

natalie (research): for success criteria, recommend three signals: product usage (DAU for feature), qualitative NPS from partner interviews, and regression-free model outputs vs baseline. all captured in our eval harness.

sam (eng): sample telemetry snippet i can push to repo:
```
events: [
  {"type": "request", "route": "generate", "tokens_in": 120, "tokens_out": 300, "latency_ms": 450},
  {"type": "feedback", "rating": 4, "tags": ["hallucination", "formatting"]}
]
```
keep it opt-in for verbose.

elaine (product): gating rubric draft: 1) integrator readiness (1-3), 2) data sensitivity (low/med/high), 3) usage potential (low/med/high), 4) strategic fit (0-2). threshold >=6 to accept. any objections?

jordan (solutions): sounds good. add 'support SLA willingness' — partners must agree to weekly check-ins for first 4 weeks or score -1.

carol (growth): on incentives — credits scale looks cheaper than cash. credits mean they'll actually use infra. proposal: base credits $500 for accepted partners, +$500 for referrals, +$200 for completed feedback cycles.

maria (pm): feedback routing proposal: triage channel -> product inbox for feature asks, eng-oncall for severity >=P1, research for qualitative notes, growth for success stories/case studies. use tags: #bug, #feature, #ops, #testimonial.

sam (eng): add automated tagger: if message contains '500 error' or 'latency' tag #ops and route to eng-oncall. i can prototype a notifier.

natalie (research): interview cadence: 2 qualitative sessions during pilot (week 2 & week 6) + one wrap survey. include 3 canonical tasks in interview guide.

elaine (product): launch criteria checklist (quick):
- >=6 partners accepted and onboarded
- avg weekly usage >= 1000 requests across cohort
- no showstopper outage in 2 weeks post-onboard
- feedback loop operational (triage + tagging + weekly digest)
- 1 case study draft ready

maria (pm): scope negotiation: we will not promise model retraining or custom model variants in pilot. we can offer config tweaks, routing policies, and telemetry. call that out in intake.

carol (growth): intake form fields suggestion: company size, primary use-case, data sensitivity, expected request volume per month, referral source. short and required.

jordan (solutions): recommend templated onboarding email with checklist and retention link. also assign a single point of contact from our side. reduces back-and-forth.

sam (eng): quick question: do we want to require usage of our SDK or allow raw REST? SDKs catch telemetry automatically.

maria (pm): prefer SDK for telemetry, but allow REST for enterprise partners who can't install SDK. in that case require manual instrumentation.

natalie (research): success metrics mapping to experiments: map NPS to product changes. any drop >10pts triggers a regression review.

elaine (product): operational runbook for feedback:
1) partner files issue → triage bot tags
2) if #bug and severity P1 -> page eng-oncall and create incident
3) feature requests go to product inbox and weekly prioritization slot
4) testimonials to growth for case study nurture

maria (pm): actions:
- sam: prototype telemetry tagger + verbose schema (target EOD tomorrow)
- elaine: formalize gating rubric and intake form (this week)
- jordan: onboarding template + SPOC assignment rules
- carol: finalize credits incentive numbers and comms copy
- natalie: draft interview guide and survey (end of week)
- me: update pilot doc, add launch criteria + scope note, publish for review by Fri

jordan (solutions): okay to run a small pilot acceptance wave next Tue? want to start onboarding asap.

maria (pm): yes — target acceptance wave Tue. i'll send calendar invites after i update the doc.

deploy-bot: automated reminder set for pilot-doc review — due 1767080000 :calendar:
